notes: Atmospheres are gone. Basalt, Iris, Midnight and Daybreak no longer exist as a separate color system — your wallpaper palette now controls the coloring of the entire launcher: the glass material is graded from the palette (deep swatch for the glass body, dominant for tint, your lead accent for the glow, light swatch for the edges), and every accent, edge, focus and muted tone in the interface derives from the same five swatches. The Background settings lose the Phone/Kinto wallpaper switch — your phone wallpaper is simply the background now — and Layout Studio's Surface tab points to the palette instead of atmosphere chips. Change the wallpaper or adjust the swatches and the whole launcher re-colors around them.
